column1: # Example sentences, hand-written for this project.
# Columns: chunks, English, and optionally other valid chunk orders (for Plug mode).
# Chunks are separated by spaces; each chunk is words joined by + and tagged with its role:
#   S subject   T time   P place   A adverb or helping verb   V verb or predicate   O object   X particle
# Punctuation (。？！，) stands alone without a role. Every word must be in the HSK word list.
# A sentence's level is the highest level of its words.
